ConceptDef.label: Forced weapons and empty guns
ConceptDef.helpText:
You forced a pawn to use a specific weapon. This pawn won't switch to its sidearm(s) when it runs out of ammo!

To override this and allow sidearms swaps on forced weapons when no ammo is available:
\Go to Mod Settings -> CE+SS Tactics -> "Forced-weapon dry fall-through".
